verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Logseq running headlessly or in CI. The local HTTP API server is a setting you enable inside the desktop app ('Features > HTTP APIs server'), and the logseq:// protocol invokes actions within the running app. Both are adjacent automation hooks, not a headless or CI execution mode, and no CLI or headless runtime is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
